text: Teijin Limited is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (stock code 3401) and reports no controlling shareholder: its largest shareholder as of March 31, 2026 is The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account), with 15.37%.
short: Teijin is Tokyo-listed; largest holder is a trust account at 15.37%.

source.note: The same page states 'Stock Exchange Listings | Tokyo Stock Exchange (Prime Market)' and 'Stock Code | 3401', with the table 'As of March 31, 2026'. The other top holders are trust/custody accounts and Goldman Sachs International (6.88%).
